§help: 1 verb(s)
verb: grep
  Search files for an RE2 pattern; skips binary and files >16 MiB.
  --pattern:string! — RE2 regex; literal text when lit=true.
  --path:string! — File or directory to search.
  --glob:string=** — Doublestar pattern; scan only matching files.
  --case:string=smart — Case sensitivity; smart is insensitive unless pattern has uppercase. [smart|sensitive|insensitive]
  --lit:bool=false — Treat pattern as literal text, not a regex.
  --max:int=256 — Max total match records; hard cap 4096.
  --mpf:int=0 — Max match records per file; 0 is unlimited.
  --cb:int=0 — Context lines before each match; max 50.
  --ca:int=0 — Context lines after each match; max 50.
  --context:int=0 — Symmetric context; sets both --cb and --ca.
  --fo:bool=false — Return only paths of files with at least one match.
  --no-text:bool=false — Omit matched line text; render path:line:col only.
  --depth:int=0 — Max depth; 0 is unlimited.
  --hidden:bool=false — Include directories starting with '.' when true.
  --gi:bool=true — Apply .gitignore from the walk root.
  --absolute:bool=false — Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.
